text: The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to the Boards of Management of forty-five (45) Business Improvement Areas that fall within the Toronto and East York Community Council boundaries for the new term of Council and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1.
